Versie — five time-critical deals and 28 orphans to clean is a real load, and I see you carrying Ron-tech and Doncon (both MG Advanced, $3.4K each) at the top. Here's the move: block two hours Tuesday morning to batch-call both MG Advanced accounts back-to-back while the context is fresh — that alone unsticks most of the $7,977. Lean into what you do best: your services close rate is +22pp over the team and telecom +15pp, so you have the touch when it counts. You're not alone on this — I'm personally on the orphan cleanup with you this week.

Dustin
